title: First Links: 4,000 cr once per pilot at Grand Exchange; 10 nickel ore bought at Market Prime for Cargo Lanes, 8 copper wiring bought at Cargo Lanes for Market Prime
note: 2026-11-23 03:44 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-071, P6 (newborns: their empire's missions first, then work that repeats there) and rule F34 tier 2 (home-region paid-once bootstrap, under 6 jumps). Grand Exchange's board (data/missions, 03:41 UTC): First Links, 4,000 cr, 25 Trading and 15 Navigation XP, 60 Piloting XP: deliver 8 copper wiring to Market Prime Exchange and 10 nickel ore to Cargo Lanes Freight Depot; the board gives no goods. Books (table books, 03:34 to 03:43 UTC): nickel ore asked at Market Prime 101 x 77, copper wiring at Cargo Lanes 13 x 4,125: about 1,130 cr of goods with the tax. Haven, Market Prime and Cargo Lanes are Nebula systems 1 and 2 jumps apart (scripts/map.py). Each delivery target is docked with its goods aboard and docked again (redock); the runner hands in a mission whose objectives are done at every stop. requires.empire nebula: the Nebula newborns' home work. min_credits 4,300: the runner buys nothing under 3,000 cr. A test: one ship first (F34, F12); three results decide (F37). 2026-11-23 04:17 UTC (Mercury): off: two runs (03:45 and 04:01 UTC) bought the goods (1,119 cr each, one_time) and handed in nothing: get_active_missions shows both delivery objectives at 0 after docking and a redock at each target with the goods aboard. The game counts a delivery for another station on complete_mission called docked there (patch notes 0.727.1); the runner calls it only for a finished mission. A hand test of that call decides the route's next form; the two pilots keep the goods and the mission. 2026-11-23 04:29 UTC (Mercury): on again in a new form, one ship. The hand test (04:20 to 04:29 UTC): the game reads a delivery objective live, at the station the pilot stands in: docked at Market Prime with the wiring aboard and the nickel in the pilot's storage at Cargo Lanes, both objectives read [DONE] and complete_mission paid 4,000 cr; with the nickel only carried through Cargo Lanes it read 0/10. So the nickel is stored at Cargo Lanes, and the runner hands the mission in on docking at Market Prime with the wiring aboard.
